name: mdocx-converter
description: Export Markdown files to DOCX with Pandoc templates and Mermaid diagram support.

mdocxConverter.mermaidCliPath.description: Path to the Mermaid CLI executable (mmdc). Required only when the Markdown file contains mermaid code fences.

mdocxConverter.referenceDocx.description: Optional path to a reference DOCX template. If empty, the extension will first look for reference.docx next to the Markdown file, then use the bundled template selected by mdocxConverter.referenceLanguage.

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect Markdown language: choose Chinese template when Chinese content is dominant, otherwise English.
Use the bundled English CSCI reference DOCX based on the official CSCI/IJMLC template.
Use the bundled Chinese CSSCI common reference DOCX.
mdocxConverter.referenceLanguage.description: Bundled reference DOCX language used when mdocxConverter.referenceDocx is empty and no local reference.docx exists next to the Markdown file.

mdocxConverter.outputDirectory.description: Optional output directory for exported DOCX files. Relative paths are resolved from the Markdown file folder.

mdocxConverter.mermaidOutputFormat.description: Rendered image format for mermaid diagrams before conversion.

mdocxConverter.openAfterExport.description: After export, open the generated DOCX location. On Windows, the file is selected in Explorer to avoid shell association pop-up failures.

mdocxConverter.keepIntermediateFiles.description: Keep temporary markdown and rendered mermaid assets for debugging.

enumDescriptions: Use the selected reference DOCX without extra metadata overrides.
Academic paper defaults: 12 pt, 1.5 line spacing, wider margins.
Business report defaults: 11 pt, 1.25 line spacing, Microsoft YaHei/Arial-oriented fonts.
Technical document defaults: compact spacing and Consolas monospace metadata.
mdocxConverter.styleProfile.description: Optional FlexMD-style document preset layered on top of the selected reference DOCX.

mdocxConverter.bodyFont.description: Optional body font metadata override, for example SimSun, Microsoft YaHei, Times New Roman, or Arial.

mdocxConverter.bodySizePt.description: Optional body font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading1SizePt.description: Optional Heading 1 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading2SizePt.description: Optional Heading 2 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading3SizePt.description: Optional Heading 3 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.lineSpacing.description: Optional line spacing multiplier, for example 1, 1.25, or 1.5. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginTopMm.description: Optional top margin in millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginBottomMm.description: Optional bottom margin in millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginLeftMm.description: Optional left margin in millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginRightMm.description: Optional right margin in millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.
